text:
Possibly, but this can't be confirmed yet. Hansen data flags about 13.5 ha of tree-cover loss in 2025 (3.9% of the 345.6 ha property). Of that area, JRC data shows 98% was forest in 2020, and the 2021 MGAP map classifies about 13.1 ha as native forest and none as planted. So the loss appears to be on native forest.

The status is "pending corroboration." 2025 is the latest year in the series, and no later year has been observed to show the change persisted.

The data also doesn't establish:
- that this is deforestation or land-use change (Hansen counts any stand replacement)
- the cause (harvest, fire, storm, clearing)
- whether it was legal
- who was responsible

Treat it as a candidate native-forest loss event to recheck when 2026 data is available.
